title: Multiple endpoints & multiplicity (FDA 2022)
source_note: FDA Multiple Endpoints in Clinical Trials (final guidance, Oct 2022)

items.title: Endpoint hierarchy
items.requirement: Primary, secondary and exploratory endpoint families are clearly designated.
items.query: hierarchy of families of endpoints primary secondary exploratory

items.title: FWER control for claims
items.requirement: Type I error is controlled across all endpoints intended to support efficacy claims.
items.query: control of type I error rate familywise multiple endpoints

items.title: Multiplicity method described
items.requirement: The multiplicity procedure (e.g. fixed sequence, fallback, Holm, Hochberg, gatekeeping, graphical) is specified, including any assumptions it relies on.
items.query: multiplicity procedures Bonferroni Holm Hochberg fixed sequence fallback gatekeeping graphical

items.title: Secondary endpoints gated
items.requirement: Secondary endpoints are tested only within the error-control strategy after primary success.
items.query: secondary endpoints tested after primary endpoint success

items.title: Co-primary endpoints
items.requirement: If co-primary endpoints are used, success requires all of them and the power calculation reflects this.
items.query: co-primary endpoints success on all power

items.title: Composite endpoints
items.requirement: Composite endpoint components, their clinical relevance and planned component analyses are described.

items.title: Arms, doses and timepoints
items.requirement: Multiplicity from multiple arms, doses or timepoints is addressed.

items.title: Sample size reflects multiplicity
items.requirement: Sample size/power accounts for the multiplicity adjustment.
